"""Run named invented-data conformance tests with open-event auditing."""

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys

COUNTS = {"restricted_opens": 0, "subprocess.Popen": 0, "os.system": 0}
BARRED = {
    "gates.yaml", "adjusted_poverty.py", "rows.py",
    "ssa_trust_fund_interest_rates_2026.json",
    "urban2010_cola_comparison.md", "urban2010_fra68_comparison.md",

    "test_anchor_provenance_erratum.py",
    "s0_1_power_results.json", "s0_1_source_audit.md", "s0_1_power.py",
    "test_s0_1_invariants.py", "test_s0_1_power.py",
    "test_s0_1_thresholds.py",
}


def audit(event, arguments):
    if event == "open" and isinstance(arguments[0], (str, bytes)):
        path = os.fsdecode(arguments[0])
        name = Path(path).name
        if (
            name in BARRED
            or name.startswith(("adjusted_poverty.", "rows."))
            or "/PolicyEngine/psid-data/" in path
            or "/microcosm-launch-evidence/" in path
            or "/dynasim-refs/" in path
            or "/claude-501/" in path
            or "/tests/s0_1/" in path
        ):
            COUNTS["restricted_opens"] += 1
            raise RuntimeError(path)
    elif event in ("subprocess.Popen", "os.system"):
        COUNTS[event] += 1


def main():
    for name in ("POPULACE_DYNAMICS_PSID_DIR", "POPULACE_DYNAMICS_EPUF_DIR"):
        assert os.environ[name] == "/nonexistent/trackb-round10"
    assert sys.argv[1:]
    sys.addaudithook(audit)
    import populace_dynamics

    expected = os.environ.get("TRACKB_ROUND10_TREE")
    if expected:
        assert str(Path(populace_dynamics.__file__)).startswith(expected)
        print("MUTATED_TREE", expected, flush=True)
    import pytest

    try:
        return pytest.main(sys.argv[1:])
    finally:
        print("OPEN_AUDIT", json.dumps(COUNTS, sort_keys=True), flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
